Reviewer: an isolated contract reviewer at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, read-only on GitHub (REST reads only; nothing written, pushed or commented), fed the card body and comments, the PR body, the net diff against the merge-base, the head's check-runs, contract-review.md and review-checklist.md. The dev report was read as input, not as conclusions; every count below is this review's own measurement. No environment variable value is printed anywhere in this record; the live sweep's token was passed by substitution and never echoed.

### ① Derived judgments

The card's letter A, its two deliverables and the PR's claims, one at a time:

1. File surface. One commit (4bf6e86b, author Claude, PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, head repo = base repo, draft, base `main`); `git diff 86d36e99 4bf6e86b --stat`, the REST file listing and the PR body agree on exactly `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` (+2/−2, blob 42d5814566) and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (+215/−0, blob cf1ab28b65). The claim's file surface (6580080463) was these two files, the row's self-test included; nothing else is touched, and neither file moved on origin/main since the merge-base. Correct, and on surface.
2. `director.md`, the new rule (line 13): 「同笔向卡的车道席敲 `Notify: ruling`,形状见 `../project-forms.md`;漏敲即录裁者欠的半状态。」 Placed directly under the recording line 12 (「录裁同笔改正文 … ⛔ 不新增标签与状态」), so the act is now: the `Ruling:` comment, the `Ruled:` body line and the bell to the card's lane seat, in one stroke, with line 12's no-label clause untouched. Consistent with the rest of the skill: project-forms.md line 44 routes exactly this bell (「记裁决席→被改席 `Notify: ruling`」) and `--mailbox-keys` prints the shape (`Notify: ruling · #n · LETTER · record ID`, sender the seat that recorded the ruling, receiver the seat whose card it changes); director.md line 21 (the director holds no `domain:*` lane) and line 17 (no patrol when not summoned) are untouched and the rule asks the director for a mailbox write it already makes elsewhere, not a label. The card's own words (Change 1) are met term for term: same stroke, knock to the card's lane seat, shape unchanged, a missing knock is the recorder's half state, no new label or state. The line is 112 bytes; no line in the file exceeds 120; `check-skill-id-lint` clean (no tracker number). Unambiguous: 「卡的车道席」 is the `domain:*` seat of the card, which is the seat the row's remedy names and project-forms' 「被改席」 for a card ruling. Correct.
3. `director.md`, the paid line (职责一). Before: 「处理三分支之一,收尾 PASS 且工已完 ⇒ 跟到合并为止。」 and, two lines later, 「到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待,⛔ 不代维护者合并。」 After, one line 39: 「处理三分支之一,收尾 PASS 且工已完 ⇒ 推进到就绪并点名等待合并,⛔ 不代维护者合并。」 The second line was the definition of the first line's 「到合并」; the merge substitutes the definition into the rule and keeps every term: the trigger (branch one, PASS, work done), the two acts (advance to ready, name the waiting), the prohibition (never merge in the maintainer's stead). The only word not carried is 「跟」 (follow), which under the deleted definition meant exactly the two acts kept, and which line 8 (「只出裁决不持在飞状态」) would in any case forbid reading as a standing watch. No obligation lost; one line in, one line out; `wc -l` 86 before and after, ceiling row 86 in check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs unchanged, ratchet green. Correct.
4. The row's population and reading (`h73SpeaksAbout`, `ruledRecords`). Issues only (`pull_request` rows out), open only, `labels` must be an array (an unreadable label set is never read as unlabelled), and the card must carry `GOVERNED_PR_DECISION_LABEL`, which is the constant `'needs-user-decision'` (line 11543). The record is a line-leading `Ruled:` read through the file's shared `directiveValues` (bullet, bold and backtick decoration tolerated, blockquotes and mid-sentence mentions not), after `stripMarkdownCode(body, { inline: false })` blanks backtick and tilde fences while keeping inline spans, and only when the value opens with a six-plus-digit comment id (`RULED_RECORD_ID`); so `Ruled: the repository variable…` is prose, and a scoped `Ruled (plugin-ai):` is not this key (see ③). The card asked for 「a line-leading `Ruled: <comment id>` while it still carries `needs-user-decision`」. Correct, and exactly the card's reading.
5. Age, threshold and the governing record. The age is read from the newest readable UTC stamp among the card's `Ruled:` lines (`RULED_RECORD_STAMP`, minutes or seconds precision, both live shapes pinned); a record with no readable stamp reports with its age unreadable rather than reading as fresh. `RULED_IN_BOX_STALE_HOURS = 6` equals `PATROL_CADENCE_HOURS` (line 21622) and a self-test case pins the equality; the comparison is `<=`, so exactly 6 h is silent and the first minute past it fires (pinned at 5h59m / 6h01m). Judgment on the band: one standing patrol cycle is the right floor for a row whose remedy is a lane seat's exit, since a lane seat patrols more often than that and a ruled card that outlived a full cycle has missed at least one exit pass; a lower threshold would alarm on cards the lane is about to move. Sensible.
6. The one exception. A card whose governing ruling id is named on its `Prior rulings on this card:` line, or on the list lines directly under it (stopping at the first blank line), is clean: that is the lawful re-entry director.md lines 54 to 55 describe (「线程有 `Ruling:`/RULED 的卡再入箱,该行逐 id 各一句变化;缺行 ⇒ 拒入」). The regex that looks for the id is built from digits only, so no injection. Once the re-entered card is ruled again, the newer stamp governs, its id is not on the prior-rulings line, and the row fires after 6 h. Correct, and the controls hold (named id clean, other id fires, id after a blank line not that line's).
7. Report-only, never fails a gate. The row returns a string or null and `sweepInto` only pushes `[issue, 'H73', text]` onto `findings`, beside H62 on the unscoped open listing already in hand (no new request). The script's header says it never writes a label and never fails a build over findings; a grep for a POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE request finds none; the live sweep below exited 0 with 364 half-states found; in lint.yml `check:pm-half-states` is `--self-test` only. The row text uses the label constant, carries no ASCII angle bracket and no tracker number (the 〈〉 around 信箱 PR are CJK brackets, and a self-test case pins `/[<>]/` and `/#[0-9]/` absent), names the lane seat for the exit and the recorder for the bell, and says in words that no label is written from the script. Band `stall`, registered in `HALF_STATE_FAMILY_BAND` with its reasons, and `isLoudFinding` is false for it. Correct.
8. Self-test and ablations, measured here. Head: 5213 cases pass, exit 0, `H73 ruled card in the decision box 28/25`. Ten ablations on the committed file, each restored to the head blob: A1 fence stripping removed (`ruledRecords` reads the raw body) → 3 red, the backtick-fence and tilde-fence cases among them; A2 label gate removed → 2 red (the same body without the label fires); A3 id requirement removed → 2 red (the prose `Ruled:` fires); A4 re-entry exception removed → 2 red (the inline and the list-form prior-rulings cases); A5 threshold removed → 3 red (the 5h59m boundary case); A6 sweep push removed, the row still computed → 7 red (H62's and H73's band-coverage cases); A7 governing stamp inverted (oldest governs) → 2 red (the newest-stamp case); A8 unreadable stamp silenced → 2 red (the no-stamp case); A9 band row deleted → 8 red; A10 closed-card gate removed → 2 red (the population case). Every piece the card's done-when names (label, fence, positive control) has a control that reds when the piece is reverted, and so do the threshold, the stamp choice, the re-entry line and the registration. The dev's five ablation counts (3, 2, 2, 2, 3) reproduce; the dev's sixth (sweep push removed, 21 red) was a different cut from A6's 7, both red.
9. Gates. `dispatch-gates --commands` from the merge-base derives 54 commands for the two paths (measured 54). Run here in their `node` form (no `node_modules` in the throwaway worktree): check-half-states `--self-test`, skill-line-ratchet (both forms), skill-id-lint (both forms), declaration-mirrors (both), issue-citations (both; 0 citations added against 86d36e99), self-test-wired (both), whole-set-label-write (both), platform-checklist, commit-card-trailers, nul-bytes (24214 files, none), entry-guard, parse-guard, skill-frame-sync, agent-test-spelling, scripts-symbol-anchors (4154 resolve), closing-target-claim, partof-closing-keyword, post-stamped (753/26), watch-hint-literal, bash32-floor, ratchet-remedy-authority, gitlink-declared, single-claim-paths, refd-timer-probe, pnpm-flag-spellings, pnpm-filter-targets, cross-package-test-inputs, sweep-closed-cards, board-snapshot, bare-root-worklist, check-harness-current: all exit 0. Nine answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) for the missing `yaml` or `typescript` dependency or absent `node_modules` (closing-keyword-parity, comment-mask-corpus, platform-checklist-watchdog, doc-authoring, governed-merges self-test, cli-command-ids, ci-filter-parity, driver-memory-census) and `check-self-test-workflow-commands` exited 1 on `release-pending-publish.mjs` missing `@changesets/cli`, a finding about this container, not the diff. CI covers those: `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are all success on the head (see the check-runs line).
10. Live read-only run. `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` against objectstack-ai/objectstack with the seat's token: exit 0; 257 open issues in the unscoped pass; two H73 rows, #28888 (`domain:spec`, ruling 6568787922, ~13h) and #29029 (`domain:server`, ruling 6573561091, ~8h). A REST listing of open `needs-user-decision` issues taken alongside shows five with a line-leading `Ruled:` (28888 04:06Z, 29029 09:25Z, 29425 14:56Z, 29465 and 29469 17:17Z) and five without; at the run (≈17:41Z) the three under 6 h were silent, which is the threshold working, and no card without a record fired. The two rows match the PR body's live reading. The head's own `Live half-state sweep` check-run is also success.
11. PR body against the head. 86 → 86 lines (measured); 5213 cases and 28/25 (measured); 54 derived commands (measured); two live H73 rows (measured); `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right (no published schema, no authorable surface); `skip-changeset` is right (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing; Check Changeset success); `Fixes #29386` is right because both done-when lines are met (the charter states the one-act rule; the patrol prints one row per ruled card past the threshold, with the three named controls in the self-test), and option B and the reverse direction were out of scope by the card's own Change 3, not deferred work. One body slip: the 维护者速读 points the reader at 「`lanes/director.md` 第 13 行与第 38 行」; the merged 职责一 line is line 39 (line 38 is the CI-red line). Cosmetic, S3.
12. Nothing new on any surface: no gate, no label, no workflow, no CODEOWNERS, no governed-register row, no package. The card, the PR body, the dev report and this record carry no finding and no mechanism.

### ② Semver level

None. No published package, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no TypeScript; governed rules text and `scripts/pm` tooling only. `skip-changeset` is the right declaration and Check Changeset is success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions`: none.
- Dev out-of-scope note (a): `dispatch-runbook.md` line 83 「机械两旗 report-only,归半状态巡查;接线是另一张卡的事,⛔ 不随协议文本改脚本」 is now half-true for 旗一, whose body-record half is H73 while its title half and its thread half (a `Ruling:` comment with no `Ruled:` body line) stay unwired. Judgment: follow-up, not a blocker. The sentence describes routing, not behaviour; no seat acts on 「另一张卡的事」 by writing anything, the card's surface and the claim (stop on breach) held the runbook out, and it sits at its 245 ceiling, so the correction is one line paid in place under a new card. S1.
- Dev out-of-scope note (b): a scoped record `Ruled (plugin-ai): ID · letter A · UTC` exists on one open card outside the box and is not read. Judgment: follow-up, not a blocker. director.md line 12 spells the record as `Ruled: <评论 id> · letter <X> · <UTC>` and the card specifies `Ruled:`; the row reads the charter's spelling exactly, and the scoped form is the off-charter one. Whether to normalise that card's line or widen the key is a ruling, carried on the same follow-up card as S1.
- Dev out-of-scope note (c): the PR carries no assignee or reviewer; os-dev.md's rule, no flag.
- Independence: PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, commit author Claude; no off-relay author note is owed. The PR thread carries the seat's `Contract-review-claim:` for this head (6583599083) and no other record.

### ④ Design judgment

Per hits file, against the card's scenario (a director records a ruling on a card in the decision box; the lane seat must learn of it and make the exit; nothing else may write the label):

- `lanes/director.md`: putting the bell into the recording stroke is the right place for it, since the recorder is the one actor who knows a ruling exists at the moment it exists, the mailbox is the one channel the lane's patrol and the sweep already read, and the alternative (option B, the director relabels) was listed and not chosen by the maintainer. Naming the missing bell as the recorder's half state gives the patrol row below its remedy's second half without inventing a state. The pay-in-place merge keeps the file at its ceiling without a ruled raise, and the merged line reads as one rule. Holds.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: reading the body record rather than the thread is the right cut for a report-only row on the unscoped listing (no comment page bought, the `Ruled:` line is the charter's own record of the thread ruling); the fence strip, the leading-anchor and the numeric-id requirement together make the predicate hard to fire by citation or prose; the newest-stamp rule and the unreadable-stamp branch are the two choices that keep the row honest on re-rulings and on malformed records; the prior-rulings exception reads the exact line the box duty already writes, so no new author convention is introduced. Threshold tied to the patrol cadence by a pinned case. Band `stall` is argued against the other three. Holds.

Must-fix: none.

- S1 (follow-up card, skills seat; no new head on this PR): one line in `dispatch-runbook.md` (paid in place at 245) so 「接线是另一张卡的事」 names what is wired (旗一's body-record half, H73) and what is not (旗一's title and thread halves, 旗二), carrying the dev's note (a) and the `Ruled (scope):` spelling question from (b) for the maintainer's word.
